content.text: Implemented the feature contract: wrapped the Changelist `list_editable` POST processing in `ModelAdmin.changelist_view` (django/contrib/admin/options.py) with `transaction.atomic(using=router.db_for_write(self.model))`, so all per-form saves, related saves, and change logging occur atomically and roll back on error. `transaction` and `router` were already imported. Public regression selection (admin_changelist, 74 tests) passes with 0 failures.
